Multiple Protests Erupt Across India and Pakistan-Administered Kashmir

Protests have emerged in various locations, including Manipur, Punjab, and Delhi, concerning issues ranging from security force actions and power crises to educational policies. Simultaneously, Pakistan-administered Kashmir has seen intensified protests related to rights concerns and economic conditions, with some leaders warning of potential shifts in allegiances. International outlets report on the aftermath of deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir and rising India-Pakistan tensions.
